title: Courtesy Credit for Long-Standing Patients on the In-Person Appointments No-Show Fee
content:
**Courtesy schedule.** A credit is taken off the no-show fee a missed In-Person Appointments visit carries as a courtesy to a long-standing patient, according to how long the patient's Patient Financial Account has been open, counted in days from the date the account was opened to the day the fee is decided:

| Account open on the day the fee is decided | Taken off the no-show fee the missed visit carries |
|---|---|
| 1826 days or more | 15.00 dollars |
| 730 to 1825 days | 10.00 dollars |
| fewer than 730 days | nothing |

The date the account was opened is shown on the Patient Financial Account.

**Edges (hypothetical accounts).** 1826 days: 15.00 dollars. 1825 days: 10.00 dollars. 730 days: 10.00 dollars. 729 days: nothing.
